CustomField.description: Title printed on the receipt PDF (Document Designer "Receipt For Flat"): RECEIPT FOR FLAT / RECEIPT FOR GST for projects that split Flat and GST receipts (The Legacey), RECEIPT otherwise (The Drizzle).
CustomField.formula: IF(Booking__r.Project__r.Legacy_Split_Demand_Receipt__c, IF(ISPICKVAL(Receipt_Type__c, 'GST Amount'), 'RECEIPT FOR GST', 'RECEIPT FOR FLAT'), 'RECEIPT')
CustomField.label: Receipt Document Title
